title: Engagement & Retention
description: Read the two signals every product lives or dies by: how engaged users are right now (DAU, stickiness, power-user curves) and whether they come back (retention and cohort curves). Tell a healthy curve from a decaying one, and a real retention gain from a flattering average.
outcomes: You'll interpret stickiness and engagement-depth signals, read a cohort-retention curve for what it says about product-market fit, and separate a genuine retention improvement from a mix effect.
